component.name: WinPodX
component.summary: Run Windows apps as native Linux windows

description.p: WinPodX runs Windows applications from a Podman or Docker container and shows each one as its own Linux window, keeping its icon, taskbar entry and file associations. You only see a full Windows desktop when you ask for one.
Windows runs in the background and starts on demand: the container pauses when idle and wakes on the next launch.

ul.li: Each Windows app opens as a native window over FreeRDP RemoteApp
Imports Start Menu apps with their icons and registers desktop entries
Two-way clipboard, audio, printers, home directory, USB and PCI passthrough
Linux apps appear in the Windows "Open with" menu
Podman by default, with Docker and manual RDP also supported
Guided first-run setup with host checks, so no terminal is required

description.p: A running Windows container needs hardware virtualization (Intel VT-x or AMD-V) and enough disk space for a Windows installation.
